units.source_text: 此诗并无特别优秀之处，然而即景抒情，催人哀思，

en.t: There was nothing especially outstanding about this poem, yet it drew feeling from the scene before them and stirred a sorrowful mood,

units.source_text: 致使源氏大将襟袖湿透。他望见池面全部冰封，率尔吟道：

en.t: so that General Genji's collar and sleeves were soaked with tears. Seeing that the entire surface of the pond was frozen over, he casually composed these lines:
